title: Judgment on the Nations

questions.question: Draw near, O nations, to hear, and give attention, O what?
For the LORD is enraged against all the nations, and furious against all their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 34:2 (ESV): "and furious against all their host;"

questions.question: All the host of heaven shall rot away, and the skies roll up like a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 34:4 (ESV): "and the skies roll up like a scroll."

questions.question: For my sword has drunk its fill in the heavens; behold, it descends for judgment upon whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 34:5 (ESV): "behold, it descends for judgment upon Edom,"

questions.question: The LORD has a sword; it is sated with blood; it is gorged with fat, with the blood of lambs and what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 34:6 (ESV): "with the blood of lambs and goats,"

questions.question: For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 34:6 (ESV): "a great slaughter in the land of Edom."

questions.question: And the streams of Edom shall be turned into pitch, and her soil into sulfur; her land shall become burning what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 34:9 (ESV): "her land shall become burning pitch."

questions.question: Night and day it shall not be quenched; its smoke shall go up how long?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 34:10 (ESV): "its smoke shall go up forever."

questions.question: But the hawk and the porcupine shall possess it, the owl and the raven shall dwell in it. He shall stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 34:11 (ESV): "and the plumb line of emptiness."

questions.question: Thorns shall grow over its strongholds, nettles and thistles in its fortresses. It shall be the haunt of jackals, an abode for whom?
And wild beasts shall meet with hyenas; the wild goat shall cry to his fellow; indeed, there the night bird settles and finds for herself a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 34:14 (ESV): "and finds for herself a resting place."

questions.question: There the owl nests and lays and hatches and gathers her young in her shadow; indeed, there the hawks are gathered, each one with her what?
Seek and read from the book of the LORD: Not one of these shall be missing; none shall be without her mate. For the mouth of the LORD has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 34:16 (ESV): "and his Spirit has gathered them."

questions.question: He has cast the lot for them; his hand has portioned it out to them with the line; they shall possess it how long?
Wild oxen shall fall with them, and young steers with the mighty bulls. Their land shall be soaked with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 34:7 (ESV): "Their land shall be soaked with blood,"

key_verse_text: Seek and read from the book of the LORD: Not one of these shall be missing; none shall be without her mate. For the mouth of the LORD has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.
